title: Evaluating the Evaluation of Music Generation Models with Generative Psychometrics
abstract: arXiv:2611.21809v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Subjective user studies are one of the major methods for evaluating music generation models. However, subjective evaluation protocols vary widely and are rarely specified in enough detail to be reproduced, hindering comparison across studies. In this paper, we map subjective evaluation methods in ISMIR music generation papers from 2020-2025 and apply generative psychometrics to assess the stability of their items. We extract 284 items from the papers' methodological descriptions, using an LLM and manual validation to standardize them. We represent these items as contextual embeddings and apply Unique Variable Analysis to remove redundant, locally dependent items and Bootstrap Exploratory Graph Analysis to estimate their latent dimensions. translated_title: 基于生成心理测量学的音乐生成模型评估方法的评估
translated_abstract: 主观用户研究是评估音乐生成模型的主要方法之一。然而，主观评估协议差异很大，且很少被详细说明到足以复现的程度，这阻碍了跨研究的比较。本文梳理了2020至2025年间ISMIR音乐生成论文中的主观评估方法，并应用生成心理测量学来评估其评估条目的稳定性。我们从论文的方法描述中提取了284个评估条目，使用大语言模型（LLM）结合人工验证对其进行标准化。我们将这些条目表示为上下文嵌入，并应用独特变量分析去除冗余和局部依赖的条目，同时采用Bootstrap探索性图分析来估计其潜在维度。结果显示，该网络收敛于一个包含六个稳定质量维度的分类体系：节奏、旋律、音频、作曲、结构和歌词，为开展用户研究指明了一条统一的方法论路径。
tldr: 本文通过对2020-2025年ISMIR音乐生成论文中的284个主观评估条目应用生成心理测量学分析，提取出节奏、旋律、音频、作曲、结构和歌词六个稳定的质量维度，为音乐生成模型的主观评估建立了统一的方法论。
en_tdlr: By applying generative psychometrics to 284 subjective evaluation items from ISMIR music generation papers (2020-2025), this study identifies six stable quality dimensions—Rhythm, Melody, Audio, Composition, Structure, and Lyrics—pointing to a unified methodology for evaluating music generation models.
